title: About SEYIK
intro: Skill & Equip Youth Initiative for Karamoja (SEYIK) is a youth-led organisation dedicated to skilling and equipping young people while building capacities to advocate for their Rights, Engage in Climate Action across the Karamoja Sub-Region of Uganda.
mission: To skill and equip Karamoja youth with vocational skills, Human Rights knowledge and Peace building tools To promote Livelihoods, Justice and peaceful co-existence in Karamoja.
vision: A skilled, equipped and peaceful Karamoja where youth live with dignity, claim for their rights and drive Inclusive development by 2040.
